messages:
miguel: quick Q — I'm updating the infra TF PR to tweak HPA min/max and enable VPA recommendations for our inference pods. wondering about interaction with our Karpenter provisioner and secret paths for custom metrics. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/1123

miguel: current HPA snippet i'm proposing:
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_horizontal_pod_autoscaler_v2" "inference" {
  metadata { name = "inference-hpa" }
  spec {
    min_replicas = 2
    max_replicas = 40
    metrics { type = "Resource" resource { name = "cpu" target { type = "Utilization" average_utilization = 60 } } }
  }
}
```

miguel: and adding VPA as "recommendation" mode, annotation on deployment
```yaml
metadata:
  annotations:
    vpa.k8s.annotation/mode: "Auto"
```

miguel: also changing provisioner to allow burst nodes:
```hcl
karpenter_provisioner {
  consolidation = true
  limits { resources = { cpu = "2000" } }
  ttl_seconds_after_empty = 300
}
```

tara: quick note — VPA Auto + HPA isn't ideal, VPA will try to change requests which can confuse HPA. prefer VPA in "Auto" only for non-HPA workloads

ashley: +1. For HPA based on CPU, set VPA mode to "Off" or "Recommender" only and apply recommendations as a manual rollout

jordan: on the Karpenter side, ttl_seconds_after_empty = 300 is fine but add a scale-down buffer for pods with long startup (kv-cache warm). we used 600 for inference last quarter

ken: also make sure metrics-server/custom-metrics has RBAC in the same namespace. Secret for prometheus adapter is at k8s-monitoring/prom-adapter-token — your TF change needs to reference that

paul: @miguel do we have quota on Dedicated capacity? if we suddenly scale to 40 pods we might hit reserved capacity and fall back to on-demand which inflates cost

miguel: we do have Dedicated, but fallback policy should route to cheaper on-demand pool. i added a routing policy in the PR; pinging @ops-bot to confirm limits

ci-bot: CI passed: terraform plan OK. 3 checks, 0 failures

deploy-bot: smoke tests queued for staging after merge

ashley: tiny nit — in the HPA hcl, use `target.average_utilization = 60` -> prefer `target.average_value` with custom metrics if we ever switch to request-based metrics

tara: final recommendation — set HPA min 3, max 30, VPA mode "Recommender" + manual apply, karpenter ttl 600, add annotation `karpenter.sh/ttl-after-empty: "600"` on provisioner

miguel: great, i'll update the PR accordingly. thanks all :thumbsup:
